notes: DiscoFlate v3.55.0 — scene groups can stagger themselves and run an outro. Every overlay gets a DELAY, so one scene group can fan its overlays out over time without a chain of wait actions — and because delay doesn't block, one video can start halfway through another and they play together. New CAMERA action: start, freeze (holds the last frame while overlays keep animating on top), resume, stop — so an outro can freeze the picture, fade to black and shut the camera down. Start repeats however you last started it, bringing the linked scene's always-on overlays back with it. New SNAPSHOT action posts the current camera frame — overlays included — to chat with an optional caption; unlike the Camera tab's browser snapshot, a command or event can fire this one. All of these work in commands, timed events, capacity events, polls, competitions and bonus rounds alike.
